<rect x="72.0" y="58.0" width="136.0" height="192.0" rx="4" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="none" stroke-width="0" opacity="0.6"/>
<text x="140.0" y="76.0" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#15803d" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="auto">largest coins first</text>
<rect x="660.0" y="54.0" width="320.0" height="80.0" rx="6" fill="#dcfce7" stroke="#15803d" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="676.0" y="76.0" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#15803d" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle">making change</text>
<text x="676.0" y="98.0" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle">largest denomination first; the remainder is always</text>
<text x="676.0" y="116.0" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle">smaller — the first two stages buy most of the amount</text>
</g>
<g class="fragment" data-fragment-index="2">
<rect x="420.0" y="58.0" width="208.0" height="192.0" rx="4" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="none" stroke-width="0" opacity="0.6"/>
<text x="525.0" y="76.0" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#dc2626" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="auto">near-Gaussian residual</text>
<rect x="660.0" y="150.0" width="320.0" height="104.0" rx="6" fill="#fee2e2" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="1.2"/>
<text x="676.0" y="172.0" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#dc2626" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle">where the metaphor fails</text>
<text x="676.0" y="194.0" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle">the late residual looks like white noise; a Gaussian source</text>
<text x="676.0" y="212.0" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#1f2328" text-anchor="start" dominant-baseline="middle">halves its distortion only per extra bit per dimension:</text>
